en.headline: New World to hand 11 SKIES back to Airport Authority
en.dek: The developer will surrender three office towers and an entertainment hub from 1 April 2027 and pay more than HK$3 billion, after an HK$18.3 billion writedown on the airport project.
body: New World Development said it had signed a termination deed with the Airport Authority Hong Kong ending its role in the 11 SKIES project at Hong Kong International Airport. The developer's subsidiary Roxy Limited will surrender the related lease from 1 April 2027.

The Airport Authority said three office towers and the entertainment complex will be handed over at no cost to the authority, and New World will pay more than HK$3 billion in cash and cash equivalents, including a HK$2.3 billion cash compensation and works and service costs of up to HK$1.05 billion. The authority said it will take over business development and management of the project as part of SKYTOPIA.

New World's annual results to the end of June included an impairment of about HK$18.32 billion on 11 SKIES. The group reported a full-year attributable loss of about HK$28.1 billion. Chief executive Echo Huang said the settlement resolved a major issue and that, excluding the writedown, core operations had returned to profit.

Chow Tai Fook Enterprises, New World's largest shareholder, indicated it was prepared to provide financial support. The Airport Authority's chief executive, Vivian Cheung, said the assets received were of leasable quality and that a dedicated subsidiary would relaunch the project.

zh.headline: 新世界交還11 SKIES予機管局 另付逾30億
zh.dek: 集團將於2027年4月1日起交還三幢辦公樓及娛樂樞紐，並支付逾30億港元；年結就項目減值約183億元。
body: 新世界發展公布，已與機場管理局就機場11 SKIES項目訂立終止契據，全資附屬公司樂斯有限公司將於2027年4月1日起交還相關租約。
機管局表示，三幢辦公大樓及娛樂樞紐將無償移交，新世界另向機管局支付超過30億港元現金及現金等價物，當中包括23億元現金補償，以及不超10.5億元的工程及服務成本。機管局將全面主導項目業務發展及管理，作為SKYTOPIA策略的一部分。
新世界截至6月底止全年業績就11 SKIES減值約183.21億元，集團列帳虧損約281億元。行政總裁黃少媚表示，安排解決了一個重大問題，撈除減值後核心業務已轉虧為盈。
最大股東周大福企業表明準備向新世界提供財務支持。機管局行政總裁張李佳蕙表示，接收的資產質素良好、可供出租，並已成立專責附屬公司重新推動項目。
